decisions.decision: Do NOT use worktree isolation for background executor agents
decisions.rationale: Intermittent Bash permission loss inside worktrees causes agents to write files but fail to commit. Run each Wave plan as a sequential foreground gsd-executor agent.

decisions.decision: Tab bar labels in all Phase 7 screen stories: ['Ride','Discover','Wallet','Account']
decisions.rationale: Per STATE.md Phase 7 decisions — differs from Phase 6 component Interactive which uses ['Home','Ride','Rewards','Profile']

decisions.decision: Dark screens (ID Scan, Facial Scan, QR Unlock Scan) override makePhoneFrame() inner bg to #0f0f0f after frame creation
decisions.rationale: Camera screens use Volt Black background — light default of makePhoneFrame must be explicitly overridden

decisions.decision: Foundation stories (border/color/elevation/grid/iconography/radius/spacing/typography) have pre-existing uncommitted modifications — do NOT stage them
decisions.rationale: These are unrelated to Phase 7 work. Already present since before Phase 6.
